title: Resolve GP8 export of legacy score-level lyrics
scope: Map binary score lyrics to a valid target track/offset representation where possible, without merging independent lyric scopes.
acceptance: Use an assigned score lyric track, multiple ordered lines and a nonzero starting measure.
Compare source text, target track and offsets with the pinned consumer; keep beat text separate.
For unassigned or unrepresentable scope, retain a specific omission and strict-policy assertion rather than silently assigning track zero.
exclusions: Do not implement a lyrics renderer or collapse beat-authored lyrics into track lyrics.

reproduction.instructions: Use an assigned score lyric track, multiple ordered lines and a nonzero starting measure.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
